Hi Liam / Priya —

Thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps to get procurement moving on our Pilot (RWI-4621):

Recap (brief)
- Pilot scope: 2 dedicated instances, 3 seats for your data science team, 90-day evaluation.
- Estimated month 1 commit: $12k/month; running on dedicated capacity.

Procurement questions we discussed
- Payment method preference: PO (standard) vs corporate card for a shorter-term pilot.
- Supplier onboarding: do you use Coupa or Ariba for supplier setup? If Coupa, we’ll need to be added as a supplier and linked to your Supplier ID.
- Marketplace: interested in options via AWS Marketplace or private listing? That can speed processing for some finance teams.

What I can provide now
- PR_template.xlsx (attached) — fill in line items and total and attach to your PR.
- Supplier_Setup_Checklist.pdf (attached) — shows the fields your procurement team will need for supplier creation (W-9, tax ID, payment terms, remittance address).
- Sample invoice & W-9 — I can send immediately if you prefer.

Suggested next steps
1) Confirm preferred commercial path: PO (preferred for contract) or card (if you want to avoid a PR for the pilot).
2) If PO: please open a Purchase Requisition (PR) in Coupa/Ariba and include the supplier ID column; if you don’t have our supplier ID yet, open supplier onboarding with the attached checklist and we’ll provide the details.
3) If you prefer Marketplace: tell me which marketplace (AWS Marketplace) and I’ll check listing availability and provide the marketplace SKU and invoice flow.
4) Please CC your internal procurement ticket/ops request (if you open one). If you prefer, I can open a partner onboarding ticket on our side (OPS-1745) to track supplier setup and invoicing.

I’m looping in Aditya and Rishi to help with supplier setup details and to provide the W-9/invoice example.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call with procurement if that helps speed things up.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap and the attachments — useful. A few things from procurement side: 

- For a $12k/month pilot we typically require a PO. Card payment is only acceptable for one-off purchases <$10k.
- We use Coupa. To create a PR we need Redwood to be set up as a supplier in our Coupa instance with a Supplier ID (our AP team provides the supplier ID back to the requestor).
- AWS Marketplace is an option — does Redwood have a Marketplace listing for the dedicated product? If available it often bypasses some of the supplier onboarding steps.

Could you send:
1) Redwood Supplier Tax ID, legal name, remittance address, and a W-9 (US).
2) Sample invoice showing line items for a monthly subscription (so my AP team can map GL codes).

I will open an internal procurement ticket (I’ll CC the ticket number once created) and will route it to Coupa onboarding if we need new supplier creation.

Thanks,
Liam
Sr. Procurement Manager | Acme Corp

Hi Liam —

Great — below are the exact items we’ll provide to help your PR and supplier onboarding go smoothly. I’m copying our ops and finance leads (Aditya, Rishi, Vanessa) so they can follow up directly with any AP questions.

What Redwood will provide (attached / inline):
- Redwood legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Tax ID / EIN: 12-3456789 (sample placeholder — we will provide a real W-9 PDF).
- Remittance address: 350 Bryant St, Suite 400, San Francisco, CA 94107
- Standard payment terms: Net 30 (we can discuss 45/60 only with exec approval).
- Sample invoice: line items mapped for monthly dedicated capacity + seat licenses (see PR_template.xlsx).

PR creation guidance (Coupa/Ariba) — recommended fields and values to include:
1) Requester: your name / department
2) Ship/Service to: Redwood Inference (list remittance address in the notes)
3) Supplier ID: leave blank if supplier not present yet and create supplier onboarding ticket in Coupa including the checklist fields.
4) Line item 1: Dedicated GPU capacity — SKU RDW-DED-02 — Qty 1 — Unit price $12,000/month
5) Line item 2: Seat licenses — SKU RDW-SEAT-01 — Qty 3 — Unit price $0 (evaluation seats) — note in PR: evaluation credits
6) GL mapping: include your internal GL code for SaaS subscriptions (AP team will map to invoice later)
7) Attachments: PR_template.xlsx + Supplier_Setup_Checklist.pdf + W-9 (once provided)

Supplier ID linkage notes
- If Coupa creates a supplier record, the Supplier ID will be returned to the PR requester; please paste that Supplier ID into the PR and reply-all so we can link invoices to that ID on our side.
- If you prefer AWS Marketplace, provide the Marketplace SKU and I’ll confirm listing; marketplace purchases are invoiced via the marketplace flow (different remit).

Internal ticketing and tracking
- If you open an internal procurement ticket, please include the HubSpot deal ID (RWI-4621) and we’ll open a corresponding ops ticket on our side: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-1745.
- Ask procurement to add the Coupa supplier ID to the ticket notes once returned.

Attachments included: PR_template.xlsx (line-item example), Supplier_Setup_Checklist.pdf. I’ll follow up with a signed W-9 and a redacted sample invoice by EOD.

If it helps, we can join a 15-min call with your AP/Coupa team this week to walk through the supplier fields.

Best,
